nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! You are Rainbow Dash!

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: The fastest of all pegasi? Of course!

nodes.speaker: rainbow_dash
nodes.text: Well, it's always a pleasure to meet one of the fans.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Come to my bar, I'll make you as much cider as you want!

nodes.speaker: rainbow_dash
nodes.text: Cider? What a superstition! I'm not some kind of alcoholic!

nodes.speaker: rainbow_dash
nodes.text: No, of course I really like cider...

nodes.speaker: rainbow_dash
nodes.text: But not because I'm an alcoholic! I just...

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Anyway, I'm waiting for you at my bar.
